notice: ATTORNEY MUST VERIFY every rule before use. These are engineering starting points, not legal conclusions. Immigration law has many exceptions (INA 245(i), immediate-relative overstay rules, waivers, TPS, parole). Flip verified to true only after review, and bump version.
owner: UNASSIGNED (open decision: which attorney owns rules and scripts)

rules.description: Urgent triage. Any flag stops intake and escalates (guardrail 5).
rules.logic: detained -> detained. Hearing date 7 days or fewer from today, including dates already past (possible missed hearing) -> hearing_within_7_days. Removal order -> removal_order. ICE contact -> ice_contact. Deadline 14 days or fewer from today, including past -> deadline_within_14_days. Stuck abroad -> stuck_abroad. In danger -> danger.

rules.description: Was the person inspected and admitted or paroled at last entry?
rules.logic: last_entry_manner in (visa, vwp, parole) -> pathway hint 'inspected_admitted_or_paroled'. ewi -> red flag 'entry.ewi' for attorney (check 245(i) and other exceptions).
overstay_length = 180_days_to_1_year AND departed_after_overstay = true -> red flag.
overstay_length = over_1_year AND departed_after_overstay = true -> red flag.
(overstay_length = over_1_year OR prior_court_or_removal in (removal_order, deported)) AND reentry_without_inspection = true -> red flag.

If goal is humanitarian or fear_of_return is true, and us_arrival_date is known: deadline = arrival date + 1 year (Feb 29 rolls back to Feb 28). If that date is past, also a red flag so the attorney checks exceptions.
Any child aged 18, 19 or 20 -> red flag for attorney to compute CSPA age. Biological age only; the engine does not compute CSPA age.

Residence date = lpr_since + 5 years, or + 3 years if married_to_usc_years >= 3 (attorney to confirm living in marital union and spouse's citizenship for 3 years). Output as a deadline-style date and a pathway hint once today is on or after it.
Earliest filing date = residence date (n400.residence) minus 90 days.
Response due = notice date + response period stated on the notice. Attorney to confirm against the notice itself (mailing rules, extensions).
Any answer other than an explicit 'no' (including 'discuss with attorney') -> red flag. The agent collects facts only (guardrail 4).

rules.description: Prior court case, removal order or removal.
rules.logic: prior_court_or_removal in (court_case, removal_order, deported, unsure) or 'discuss with attorney' -> red flag.
